$comment: Migrations an older API image cannot run against (DROP, RENAME, ALTER TYPE, SET NOT NULL). Each one needs an explicit exception. 'historical' is reserved for migrations shipped up to InitPad 0.2.35; a new exception names the exact release that ships it, and that release is published as a contract release that requires a database restore instead of an image rollback (ADR-183).
